stewart_2023.title: A Conjoined Rectilinear Collision Cell and Pulsed Extraction Ion Trap with Auxiliary DC Electrodes

classifications.reported: dimension explicitly reported in the cited paper
classifications.interpretation: declared projection or geometric interpretation of reported wording/dimensions
classifications.assumption: project completion, coordinate placement, numerical discretization or operating seed; not a reported manufacturer dimension

entries.explanation: Published HP/LP segment lengths and inscribed radius are retained as dimension seeds; this does not supply all mechanical dimensions.
The reported extraction slit is 8 mm by 0.8 mm; cuts through finite model plates and shield are project projections.
Reported HP auxiliary inner-distance endpoints are used; conversion to four corner coordinates and finite stair surfaces is an implementation interpretation.

Reported opposed gaps 4 mm at the center and 3.7 mm at the ends are interpreted as INNER SURFACE gaps; model half-gaps are 2 and 1.85 mm. Sheet thickness grows away from the ion volume, not into the reported gap.

entries.location: Figure 3 and LP inner auxiliary-electrode description
entries.explanation: Reported 2.5 mm local axial length is projected as a half-length of 1.25 mm; unreported transverse placement and thickness remain assumptions.
The paper wording 2 mm steel aperture is interpreted as circular DIAMETER, not radius or r0; model bore radius is 1 mm. Plate thickness and exact manufacturing shape are not verified.
0.1 mm PA grid and 60 midpoint stair segments per auxiliary structure are numerical choices approximating the reported continuous geometry, not physical segmented electrodes reported by the paper.
Halfwidths 3/3.5 mm are project boundary/shield choices. Their HP/LP common-mode tracking is modeled; dimensions are not attributed to manufacturer CAD.
Plate widths/thicknesses and unreported auxiliary transverse dimensions complete a solvable solid geometry; no manufacturer dimensions are claimed.

entries.location: project apparatus placement and upstream abstraction
entries.explanation: LP center 170 mm, HP center and upstream 30 mm guide/rod dimensions are coordinate and functional-model choices; the guide is not a reconstruction of the full instrument frontend.
Finite lens dimensions, clearances, numerical Dirichlet boundary and diagnostic measurement plane are project definitions, not reported instrument CAD.
The 50 V end-lens setting is a functional-model operating seed, not a reported commercial-device voltage.

limitations: Figure references identify the apparatus/auxiliary-electrode source; this mapping is not a manufacturing drawing.
Reported geometry must not be extended to unreported thickness, shield, placement or voltage dimensions.
Any model using changed geometry requires a new field identity and Refine; legacy exploration does not validate it.
